info.title: MonkeyWorkout API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs` from docs/api/endpoints.md. Conventions: docs/api/README.md.

get.summary: Liveness for Fly checks → {ok, mail} (mail = transport: ses, smtp or console)
AASA JSON for passkeys (webcredentials) on this host
get.description: Errors / limits: 404 not_found when not configured

get.summary: Privacy Policy (HTML, operator from LEGAL_* env)
Terms of Use / EULA (HTML)
Support page (HTML)
Flags, values, minimumBuild / recommendedBuild, update, packs by SHA-256; ETag, X-Content-Signature (Ed25519, when CONTENT_SIGNING_KEY set)
get.description: Errors / limits: 304 on If-None-Match; 120/min per IP

get.summary: Content pack (recipes, foods, whats-new, coach-tips), immutable
get.description: Errors / limits: 404 not_found on unknown name or hash; 120/min per IP

post.summary: {email, password, name?, acceptedTerms} → 202 verification_required; 6-digit code emailed. Enumeration-safe
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 weak_password, breached_password, terms_required; auth rate limit

post.summary: {email, code, password?} → {user, tokens}
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 invalid_code, too_many_attempts; auth rate limit

post.summary: {email} → 202 sent_if_pending
post.description: Errors / limits: once per minute per address; auth rate limit

post.summary: {email, password} → {user, tokens} or 403 mfa_required {mfaToken, methods} when 2-step is on
post.description: Errors / limits: 401 invalid_credentials; 403 email_not_verified; 429 account_locked {lockedUntil}; auth rate limit

post.summary: {identityToken, authorizationCode?, name?, nonce?} → {user, tokens, created}. Links a verified email; code exchanged for an Apple refresh token (revoked on deletion)
post.description: Errors / limits: 401 invalid_apple_token; auth rate limit

post.summary: Completes 2-step: {mfaToken, code | recoveryCode} → {user, tokens}
post.description: Errors / limits: 401 mfa_expired, invalid_code; 429 too_many_attempts; auth rate limit

post.summary: WebAuthn assertion options → {challengeId, options}
{challengeId, response} (WebAuthn assertion JSON) → {user, tokens}
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 challenge_expired; 401 passkey_invalid; auth rate limit

post.summary: {refreshToken} → a new token pair {accessToken, refreshToken, ...} (not wrapped in tokens; single-use rotation)
{refreshToken} → 204, revokes that session
{email} → 202 sent_if_exists
{email, code, newPassword} → 204; signs out every device (access tokens too)
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 invalid_code, weak_password, breached_password; auth rate limit

get.summary: → {user} (id, email, name, verified, sign-in methods)

delete.summary: {confirm: "DELETE", password?} → 204. Permanent: cascades every row, rate-limit records and call-name recordings, revokes Sign in with Apple; spends the grant

post.summary: {currentPassword?, newPassword} → {tokens}; every other session and access token ended, email notice; spends the grant
{newEmail, password?} → 202; code sent to the new address. Enumeration-safe; spends the grant
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 same_email; auth rate limit

post.summary: {code} → {user}; old address notified
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 invalid_code, too_many_attempts; 409 email_taken; auth rate limit

get.summary: → {sessions: [{device, createdAt, expiresAt}]} signed-in devices, newest first

post.summary: → 204, revokes every refresh token, access token and open re-auth grant

get.summary: Full JSON export of the member's data (nFADP / GDPR), streamed: synced records in time order, machine-note photos, community profile (level, pronouns, photo), reports filed, library saves, plan copies, Garmin watches and inbox, passkeys (id, name, dates), 2-step on/off, watch key set or not

post.summary: Report a problem: {kind bug|broken|idea, area, text, screen?, error?, via, app{version, build, os, device, locale?}, screenshots[≤3 base64 JPEG]} → 201 {id, issueNumber}

get.summary: → overview: sign-in methods, 2-step on/off, recovery codes left, passkeys

post.summary: Emails a 6-digit re-auth code → 202
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 no_verified_email; resend once a minute; auth rate limit

post.summary: → {challengeId, options} for a passkey re-auth
One of {method: password, password}, {method: apple, identityToken, nonce?}, {method: email_code, code}, {method: totp, code}, {method: passkey, challengeId, response} → {reauthToken, expiresIn: 300}
post.description: Errors / limits: 401 reauth_failed; 429 too_many_attempts; auth rate limit

post.summary: → {secret, otpauthUrl} (pending until enabled)
{code} → {recoveryCodes} (10, shown once)
→ new {recoveryCodes}; old ones void

get.summary: → {passkeys} (id, name, created, last used)

post.summary: {challengeId, response, name?} → {passkeys}
WebAuthn registration options → {challengeId, options}

get.summary: → {data, updatedAt} opaque app profile JSON

put.summary: {data} → {updatedAt} (last write wins)

get.summary: → {logs, deleted?, serverTime} set logs {id, date, exerciseId, sessionId?, weightKg?, lowerKg?, reps?, setIndex?, rir?} (lowerKg = lowering load when the machine sets it apart, #792; weightKg is then the push)

post.summary: {logs[≤500]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {workouts, deleted?, serverTime} completed sessions (opaque JSON with id, startedAt)

post.summary: {workouts[≤100]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {workouts, deleted?, serverTime} member-built workouts (id, name, items[].exerciseId, visibility; other app fields kept as sent, e.g. routine {color, symbol} for own daily routines, #732)

post.summary: {workouts[≤100]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}; visibility members/public shares it to the library; new or renamed shared names are AI-checked (#871)
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 objectionable_content (word filter or AI check); 403 community_profile_required to share; 409 quota_exceeded; 413 too_large

get.summary: → {exercises, deleted: [], serverTime} (deletion = archived flag)

post.summary: {exercises[≤20]} (photo base64 JPEG inside, metadata stripped) → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {attempts, deleted?, serverTime} (exerciseId, date, kind oneRepMax|repMax|maxReps, kg, reps, success)

post.summary: {attempts[≤200]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {measurements, deleted?, serverTime} (date, girthsCm, weightKg, bodyFatPct)

post.summary: {measurements[≤200]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {climbs, deleted?, serverTime} climbing sessions (optional place {id, name, address?, latitude?, longitude?, gymId?, kind?}, #832; kind = place type such as climbingGym, crag, skiResort, #960)

post.summary: {climbs[≤200]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

get.summary: → {sports, deleted?, serverTime} other sport sessions (snowboard, MTB, Hyrox…; optional place as climbs, #832)

post.summary: {sports[≤200]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}
→ {key}: upload key for the Apple Watch's direct sport upload (replaces the previous one)
Watch uploads finished sport sessions without the phone: {sports[≤10]} → {saved, serverTime}

get.summary: → {notes, deleted?, serverTime} private machine setup notes (gym, exercise, fields, text, splitLoad? push/lower loads apart #792, photoId)

post.summary: {notes[≤200]} → {saved, serverTime, conflicts?}

put.summary: Raw image/jpeg body, EXIF stripped → {photoId, updatedAt}
put.description: Errors / limits: 404 not_found (sync the note first); 415 unsupported_media_type; 400 invalid_image; 409 quota_exceeded

get.summary: JPEG, owner only, Cache-Control: private
?ids=a,b (≤300 catalog recipe ids) → {summaries{id: {reviews, stars, rated, valuesRight, flagged}}, mine{id: {stars, numbers, cooking, updatedAt}}} anonymous counts (#1017)

put.summary: {stars?1–5, numbers?: right|portion-big|portion-small|kcal-off, cooking?: easy|steps-unclear|took-longer} (at least one) → {mine, summary}; one review per member and recipe
{token (hex), env sandbox|production, topic (bundle id), tz?} → {ok, pushConfigured}; a token moves to the last account registering it

delete.summary: {token} → 204 (sign-out); token in the body so it stays out of URLs and logs

get.summary: → {prefs, pushConfigured}: toggles, reminder / check-in times, quiet hours (minutes after midnight)

put.summary: {prefs} (any subset; what it leaves out keeps its saved value) → {prefs}

post.summary: {achievements[≤30]: {id, type, text}} → {announced}; each new id pushed once to followers, at most 20 a day per member; text with a link or domain → 400 links_not_allowed (#922)
Test push to own devices → {devices, sent, pushConfigured}

get.summary: → {profile} account profile (nickname, about, photo), joined or not

put.summary: {nickname?, bio?} → {profile}
Raw image/jpeg ≤ 512 KB, 64–1024 px, metadata stripped → {profile}; AI-checked (#871), a flagged photo is refused and the old one stays

get.summary: → community profile (nickname, bio, defaultVisibility private|members|public, autoShare, gym) or null

put.summary: Join / update; joining needs acceptGuidelines: true → profile
put.description: Errors / limits: 400 guidelines_required, nickname_required, objectionable_content (word filter or AI check, #871); 409 nickname_taken

delete.summary: Leave: profile, photo, posts, cheers and the reports you filed removed → 204

put.summary: {level 1–999} → {level}
{pronouns: string | null} (≤ 24 chars) → {pronouns}

Socials (#745): {socials: {instagram?, tiktok?, strava?, youtube?}, visibility? everyone|following|nobody}; handles without @, empty removes → {socials, visibility}. Members see them on GET /v1/community/members/:userId per visibility (default following)
Same as public-profile avatar (older apps)

get.summary: Avatar JPEG; unguessable id, immutable cache
?scope=members|following|mine&before=ISO&beforeId=&limit= → {posts, nextBefore, nextBeforeId}; blocks applied both ways

post.summary: Share a win: {id (client UUID), kind workout|badge|record|climb|note, refId?, payload, caption?, visibility?} (refId dedupes; an update keeps the caption and visibility it leaves out) → post; text members haven't seen yet is AI-checked (#871): flagged → 400 objectionable_content, nothing stored. payload: {title, subtitle?, metric?, style?, stats?, exercises?}; a workout sends up to 40 exercises {id, name, sets, reps?, kg?} so members can open and copy it (#779)

put.summary: Cheer (like, strong, fire, clap, beast, banana), not on own posts → {post}

delete.description: Errors / limits: 404 not_found (post you can't see)

get.summary: Find members: ?q= nickname or gym, ?gym=mine, ?limit≤50; empty q = suggestions → {members}
Add a friend by invite code (#747), case-insensitive, any account age → {member}
get.description: Errors / limits: 400 own_code; 404 invalid_code, not_joined (code real, owner not in Social); 403 community_profile_required

get.summary: → {member, posts, blockedByMe, followedByMe}
get.description: Errors / limits: 404 not_found (not a member, blocked, or hidden by reports)

get.summary: Members you follow, by nickname: ?limit=1–500 (default 500)&after=nickname → {following, nextAfter}

put.summary: Follow → 204

post.summary: {postId | userId, reason spam|harassment|hate|sexual|violence|other, details?} → 202 {status: received, hidden}; auto-hidden after 3 distinct reporters, mailed to moderation

get.summary: → blocked members

post.summary: {userId} → 204; also removes follows both ways

get.summary: Gym buddies (#626) → {buddies: [{userId, nickname, avatarUrl, level, status paired|invited|invites_you, live, shareLive}]}; shareLive false when you keep your live set from them (#675); live (title, exercise, detail, state set|rest|done, updatedAt) only when paired and sent in the last 10′

put.summary: Invite, or accept an invite → {status: paired|invited}; up to 20; push buddy_invite (actorId, actorName) to the invitee, or to the inviter once paired

patch.summary: {shareLive} → {shareLive}: keep your live set from this buddy or share it again (#675)

delete.summary: Unpair, cancel or decline → 204; blocking or leaving the community also unpairs

post.summary: {kind fire|banana|beast} to a paired buddy → 204

put.summary: Live set for buddies and the challenge room: {title, exercise, detail?, state set|rest|done, challengeWeek?} → 204; one row, replaced per set

get.summary: ?after= last id seen → {cheers: [{id, from: {userId, nickname}, kind, at}], last}; last 10′ only

Weekly challenge room: ?week=YYYY-Www (default this ISO week) → {week, wod: {name, format amrap|emom|fortime|tabata, minutes, moves, by, memberWeek, card, deckSize}, next: {week, memberWeek, format, minutes, moveCount}, history[4]: {week, name, rank}, vote: {week, endsAt, finalists[≤3]: {id, name, format, minutes, moves, by, votes, mine}}, joined, training, leaderboard[≤20]: {rank, userId, nickname, avatarUrl, level, rounds, reps, seconds, tier, live, me}, me}. #748: the WOD comes from a 60-card deck shuffled per year (no repeat in a year); the last ISO week of each month runs the voted member suggestion (picked when the week starts, deck if none); blocks and hidden members left out of ranks and counts
get.description: Errors / limits: 400 invalid_request (week that doesn't exist); 403 community_profile_required

put.summary: {week, rounds? 0–200, reps? 0–999, seconds? (For time, finished under the cap), tier? easy|rx|beast (default rx)} → {week, rounds, reps, seconds, tier, rank, best}; AMRAP/EMOM rank rounds + reps, Tabata reps, For time finishers by time above unfinished by reps; tier ranks first; the best score stays
put.description: Errors / limits: 400 week_closed, over_cap, invalid_request (empty score)

get.summary: Your challenge suggestions (#748) → {suggestions: [{id, name, format, minutes, moves, status pending|approved|rejected, week, createdAt}], moves}; moves = the kit-free move list suggestions use

post.summary: {name 2–32, format, minutes, moves[2–5]} → 201 {suggestion} pending owner review; Coach check: moves from the list, reps 1–50 (EMOM 30, For time 100; Tabata names only, 4′ per move), minutes per format (AMRAP 5–20, EMOM 6–20, For time 5–25)

delete.summary: Withdraw your suggestion that hasn't run → 204

put.summary: {suggestionId} one of the finalists → {week, suggestionId}; one vote per member for the next member week, changeable until it starts

get.summary: Shared plans (#666), newest first: ?q= name, ?level=beginner|intermediate|advanced, ?mine=1 your own (private too), ?before=&beforeId= (creation time), ?limit= → {programs: [{id, name, about, level, goal, weeks, sessionsPerWeek, programme, author, mine, visibility, copies, copiedByMe, hidden}], nextBefore, nextBeforeId}; blocked and auto-hidden left out
One plan → {program}

put.summary: Create or update your plan: {name ≤60, about?, level, goal?, weeks, sessionsPerWeek, programme (app record), visibility? (default members)} → {program}; shared text is AI-checked (#871)
put.description: Errors / limits: 400 objectionable_content (word filter or AI check), 409 conflict, 413, 429 daily_limit (20 new/day)

delete.summary: Remove your plan → 204 (also when already gone)

post.summary: Counts a copy into My programmes (once per member; the app saves the copy) → {program}
{reason, details?} → 202 {status: received, hidden}; auto-hidden after 3 distinct reporters

get.summary: Public web card of a public post (HTML, Open Graph)
Invite page (#745): inviter's nickname, code, link to get the app (INVITE_APP_URL)
→ {code, path, joined, subscribed, invitedBy: {nickname, at} | null, canRedeem}; subscribed = invitees with a paid (non-trial, not revoked) App Store subscription

post.summary: {code} (case-insensitive), accounts ≤ 14 days old, once → same as GET. Inviter and invitee follow each other once both are in Social (#747; also on join)
post.description: Errors / limits: 404 invalid_code; 400 own_code, account_too_old, referral_cycle; 409 already_redeemed; 10/hour

get.summary: Members' shared workouts, newest first: ?q=, ?before=&beforeId=, ?limit= → {workouts, nextBefore, nextBeforeId}; blocked and auto-hidden left out
One shared workout

post.summary: Counts a copy into My workouts → {workout}
{reason, details?} → 202 {status: received, hidden}; auto-hidden after 3 distinct reporters

put.summary: Your equipment list for a gym {gym{id, name, lat?, lon?}, equipment[], unsure[]} (latitude/longitude also accepted) → {saved} (replaces yours, also at the same place under another id)

get.summary: ?id=&name=&lat=&lng= → what members report, one vote per member: {place: {members, votes, equipment} | null, chain: {members, votes, equipment, name, gyms} | null}

put.summary: Your floor plan {gym, layout{zones[], door?, sizeM?}} → {saved} (one per place)

get.summary: ?id=&name= → {map: {layout, members, agreement} | null} the plan members agree with most (yours excluded)

post.summary: "Taken?" tap {gym{id}, zone} → {saved} (one per member, gym, zone per 5 min; hourly cap)

get.summary: ?id=&tz= → busy zones now and by hour
→ {available, remainingToday}

post.summary: {turns[1–30]{role member|coach, text}, context{goal, level, sessionMinutes, equipment, readiness, todayPlanned, method, screen, focus, pronouns, callName, memory, exercises[≤400 names], todayExercises[≤40 names], weekday 1–7 (#999)}, photo?} (photo: base64 JPEG ≤1.5 MB of a machine, sent with the last message, #856) → {reply, workout?, action?, suggestions, exercises, protect?{area neck|shoulder|elbow|wrist|lower-back|hip|knee|ankle, side left|right|both, level mild|loaded|sharp, seeDoctor} (#870 train around pain), measurement?{weightKg, bodyFatPct, girths[{site neck|shoulders|chest|waist|hips|upperArm|forearm|thigh|calf, side left|right|none, cm}]} (#1000 log body measurements; the app saves them on today's entry with Undo), doActions[≤5]{kind water|food|mood|move|skip|swap|done|reminder|voice|supplement, glasses 1–10, foods (food words, or supplement name), meal breakfast|lunch|dinner|snack, mood 1–5, weekday 1–7 (move: later than today, done: earlier), from (one of todayExercises), to, minutes 0–1439, on, value whenTalking|always|never} (#999 Coach can act: allowlist only, other fields null), remainingToday} (exercises: ≤4 names from context.exercises, screens freestyle and picker #934)
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 bad_photo; 402 pro_required; 429 daily_limit, busy; 502 coach_failed; 503 coach_unavailable

post.summary: Weekly Coach review (#867): {digest{weekOf YYYY-MM-DD, goal?, level?, days[]{weekday 1–7, title, done, minutes?}, bests[], sleepHours?, hrv?, mood? 1–5, moodAbout[], next[]{id, weekday, title, lifts[]{uid, name, sets}}, offDays[]}} → {weekOf, score 0–100, headline, summary, changes[≤3]{kind move|skip|lighter|addSet, sessionId, weekday?, uid?, label}}; changes only name next workouts and lifts; 3/day per member
post.description: Errors / limits: 400; 402 pro_required; 429 daily_limit, busy; 502 coach_failed; 503 coach_unavailable

post.summary: Talk to Coach mid-set (#874): {question 1–300, context{exercise, set, sets, kg?, reps?, step 0.25–20 (2.5), done[]{kg, reps, rir?}, lastTime?, restSec?, swaps[≤4]{id, name}}} → {answer ≤240, actions[≤2]{kind weight|swap|rest, kg? | exerciseId? | sec?}}; weight 60–130 % of kg on the step grid, swap only from swaps, rest 30–600 s, one per kind; 30/day per member. The app tries its own rules and the on-device model first
post.description: Errors / limits: 400; 402 pro_required; 429 daily_limit, busy; 502 coach_failed; 503 coach_unavailable

post.summary: Set up the plan with Coach (#873), "say it once": {text 3–500} → plan form values {goal balanced|build|strength|climbing|endurance|athletic, experience, sessions 2–6, weekdays[1–7], minutes 45|60|75|90|null, climbs, climbDays 1–4|null, protect{area neck|shoulder|elbow|wrist|lower-back|hip|knee|ankle, side left|right|both, level mild|loaded|sharp}|null (turns on pain mode #870), summary}. Free (onboarding); 15 a day per member with /help
post.description: Errors / limits: 400, 429 daily_limit / busy, 502 coach_failed, 503 coach_unavailable

post.summary: "Not sure? Ask Coach" on a plan form step (#873): {step, options[1–12]{id, label}, so[] (answers so far), question?} → {answer, pick (an option id) | null}; same cap as /v1/me/coach-plan
{photo (base64 JPEG ≤ 1.5 MB), catalog[≤150]{id, label}} → {items, remainingToday} equipment seen

{photo, catalog[≤400], mode? fridge|plate|auto} → {items, found[{id | new food, sure, alcohol, per100}], remainingToday}; plate (#723, a cooked meal) adds dish and per food grams, caffeine (mg/100 g); auto (#733, Magic Snap) answers like plate plus kind meal|stock (stock: dish ""); one daily count for all modes

{pantry[1–300]{id, label}, meal breakfast|lunch|dinner|snack, left{protein, carbs} (g still to eat today), diet?, avoid[]?} → {ideas[≤3]{name, minutes, foods[{id, grams}] (pantry ids only), steps[≤5]}, remainingToday} (#869, "What can I eat?"; macros added up on the device)
post.description: Errors / limits: 402; 403 verification_required; 429 daily_limit (20/day), busy; 502 ideas_failed; 503 ideas_unavailable

post.summary: {link? (≤500), caption? (≤4000), text? (≤2000, member's own words), photos[≤4] (base64 JPEG ≤ 1.5 MB each), catalog[1–600]{id, label}} → {name, minutes, items[≤40]{said, id (catalog id or ""), sets, reps, unit reps|sec|min, sure}, source?{platform tiktok|instagram|youtube|web, url (tracking dropped), author?}, remainingToday} (#909, save a workout seen on TikTok / Instagram; no caption → TikTok / YouTube public oEmbed; video never fetched, photos not kept)
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 bad_link, bad_photo; 402; 403 verification_required; 422 nothing_to_read; 429 daily_limit (20/day), busy; 502 import_failed; 503 import_unavailable

get.summary: → {available, voices, lines[{id, text, hash}]}; available: false (200) when voices aren't configured
MP3 of one line (made once with Polly, cached on the volume)
MP3 of the short call with the member's name (X-Call-Name header); kept in memory for an hour, never on disk; a new name counts against AI_DAILY_LIMIT
→ {mode, pro, access, source subscription|grant|none, productId, expiresAt, trial, willRenew, grant, products, test?}

post.summary: {signedTransaction, signedRenewalInfo?} StoreKit 2 JWS, verified to Apple Root CA - G3 → entitlement
post.description: Errors / limits: 400 invalid_transaction, unknown_product, sandbox_transaction; 403/409 subscription_other_account

put.summary: Staging only (SUBSCRIPTION_TESTS=on and account in SUBSCRIPTION_TEST_EMAILS, else 404, #924): {mode off|preview|enforced|null} for this account → entitlement

post.summary: Staging only: fake purchase {productId} → entitlement
Staging only: {end?} → entitlement
App Store Server Notifications V2 {signedPayload} → 200 / 400
Watch asks for a pairing code: {model?} → {token, code, expiresAt}

post.summary: {events[≤50]} sets, finished workouts, water → {saved, serverTime}
{code} typed in Settings › Watches → {id, model, pairedAt}

get.summary: → paired watches
